meta.title: Vitrine do Peixe — Connecting production to market
meta.description: Vitrine do Peixe — B2B platform connecting Amazonian fish production to the market.

sobre.title: The showcase Amazonian fish deserved
sobre.p1: Vitrine do Peixe is part of the Bússola do Peixe Amazônico project, a startup born in the Amazon with a clear mission: to shorten the path between those who produce and those who buy quality Amazonian fish.
sobre.p2: Amazonian producers struggle to reach buyers outside their region. Buyers don't know where to find reliable suppliers. Vitrine solves this problem simply: a place where producers get seen, and buyers find what they need.

pillar1.title: Guaranteed origin
pillar1.desc: Products with traceability and provenance straight from the Amazon.

pillar2.title: Direct connection
pillar2.desc: Producers and buyers meet without unnecessary middlemen.

pillar3.title: Real impact
pillar3.desc: We strengthen local production chains and the sustainable Amazonian economy.

produtor.title: Your production deserves to be seen
produtor.p1: Many Amazonian producers sell only to people they already know — not for lack of product, but for lack of reach. On Vitrine, you get a public profile with your products, region and contact details. Buyers from all over Brazil can find you and reach out directly.
produtor.p2: Bússola never gets in the middle of a deal and never charges commission on any sale. The agreement is made between you and the buyer, however works best for both of you.

card1.title: Public profile
card1.desc: Your name, products and region visible to buyers across Brazil.

card2.title: Direct contact
card2.desc: Buyers talk to you directly. No long forms, no middleman.

card3.title: No commission
card3.desc: Bússola never charges anything on your sales. What you negotiate is yours.

card4.title: Credibility
card4.desc: A verified profile builds trust with buyers purchasing for the first time.

comprador.title: Find the right fish, from the right source
comprador.p1: On Vitrine you search producers by species, region or available volume and contact the source directly. No fees, no middlemen, no surprises. Bússola connects both sides and lets the negotiation happen between you.

card1.title: Search by species and region
card1.desc: Filter by fish type, location and availability to find what you need.

card2.title: Verified producers
card2.desc: Every profile is reviewed before appearing on the platform.

card3.title: Direct negotiation
card3.desc: Talk to the producer and work out the details without third parties.

card4.title: Amazonian species
card4.desc: Access native species that rarely reach conventional channels.

industria.title: Direct access to Amazonian production
industria.p1: Vitrine is also a channel for industries looking to get closer to Amazonian production. Find producers, negotiate volume, and advertise your products and promotions on a platform reaching an audience already in the sector.

card1.title: Contact with producers
card1.desc: Negotiate directly with producers, with no middlemen involved.

card2.title: Ads on the platform
card2.desc: Promote your products to a targeted audience in the Amazonian fishing sector.

card3.title: Promotions and campaigns
card3.desc: Launch seasonal offers and campaigns directly within Vitrine.

card4.title: Supply overview
card4.desc: See what's available in Amazonian production to plan your demand.

como.title: Simple for everyone
como.p1: Registration is free and takes just a few minutes. See how each profile uses the platform.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.text: Access the platform and choose the Producer profile. Registration is free.

step2.title: Build your profile
step2.text: Add your location, the species you produce and the volumes available.

step3.title: Wait for verification
step3.text: Our team validates your profile before it appears to buyers.

step4.title: Receive contacts
step4.text: Interested buyers reach out to you directly to negotiate.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.text: Access the platform and choose the Buyer profile. Access is free.

step2.title: Search producers
step2.text: Filter by species, region or available volume until you find what you need.

step3.title: Get in touch
step3.text: Click the producer's profile and start the conversation directly with them.

step4.title: Negotiate and close
step4.text: Price, volume and logistics are arranged directly between you and the producer.

step1.title: Get in touch
step1.text: Talk to our team to introduce your company and understand the options available.

step2.title: Access producers
step2.text: Search suppliers by species, region and volume, just like the buyer profile.

step3.title: Advertise on the platform
step3.text: Set up your ads and promotions to appear to Vitrine's users.

step4.title: Negotiate directly
step4.text: Contact with producers happens directly. Bússola doesn't intermediate or charge commission.

disclaimer.strong: Bússola doesn't charge commission and doesn't intermediate negotiations.
disclaimer.text: Access to Vitrine is free for producers and buyers. Our role is to connect both sides. What happens after that is between you.
